title: Normalize Flow Plugin Crate To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize flow/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the repo-wide Consistency Contract: adopt SDK PanelKit (tree_item*/PanelTreeBuilder) for build_document_tree/build_catalogue_tree, adopt SDK Terminology (app_labels!/LocaleLabels/resolve_labels/localized_label_map/AppLabelsOverlayExt) replacing the hand-rolled FlowPlayLabels struct+consts+resolver and flow_action_labels/app_labels struct-literal, adopt SDK Testkit (testkit::meta/new_app/paired_apps/assert_undo_redo_round_trip) replacing local test scaffolding, verify resource_kind() already present, verify C1 naming (FlowPlayApp already matches PascalCase("flow-play")+"App"), fix regions (wrap tests mod in //#region 🧪️Tests / //#endregion 🧪️Tests; confirm canonical region order), confirm single-app crate stays flat (no app_<name> mod wrapping needed).
summary:
Normalized flow/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the Consistency Contract by migrating onto the framework SDK primitives extracted from this crate's own former reference implementation.

PanelKit: deleted the crate's local `tree_item`/`tree_item_with_action`/`tree_item_with_action_draggable` (verbatim duplicates of the now-shared SDK versions) and rewrote `build_document_tree`/`build_catalogue_tree` on `PanelTreeBuilder` + `tree_item_desc`/`tree_item_with_action`/`tree_item_with_action_draggable` from `semio_framework_plugin`. The SDK's draggable helper takes an already-shaped `{mime: payload}` JSON object (vs. this crate's old single-hardcoded-MIME wrapper), so added a 3-line `flow_widget_drag_json()` adapter and updated its 4 call sites. `build_inspector_tree` was untouched (already used `ui_inspector_groups_to_tree`, not a PanelKit target).

Terminology: replaced the hand-rolled `struct FlowPlayLabels` + `FLOW_LABELS_NATIVE_EN`/`_DE` consts + `flow_labels()` resolver fn with `semio_framework_plugin::app_labels!` (generates the struct + EN/DE + `LocaleLabels` impl) and `resolve_labels::<FlowPlayLabels>(view_state)` at the two call sites (`render`, `app_labels`). Replaced `flow_action_labels`'s manual `(id,en,de)` fold with `localized_label_map`. Replaced `app_labels()`'s hand-built `AppLabelsOverlay { .. }` struct literal with the `AppLabelsOverlayExt` fluent builder (`.window_kind_label`/`.mode_label`/`.action_labels`/`.example_labels`); also swapped the inline `locale.starts_with("de")` check for `is_de_locale`. `flow_extension_label`/`flow_extension_action_title_label` (app-specific id->label lookups, not part of the SDK's generic pattern) were left untouched.

Testkit: replaced the local `meta()`/`new_app()` fns and `#[cfg(test)] use vcs::MemoryBackbone` scaffolding with `semio_framework_plugin::testkit::{meta, new_app, paired_apps, assert_undo_redo_round_trip}`; updated all ~13 `new_app()` call sites to `new_app::<FlowPlayApp>()`. `undo_restores_fixture_after_add_widget` (an exact undo-redo-round-trip shape) now calls `assert_undo_redo_round_trip`. `two_instances_converge_on_disjoint_edits` keeps its bespoke assertions (checks specific widget identity/kind on each side, not just probe equality — not reducible to `assert_two_instances_converge`'s single-probe-equality contract) but its manual `MemoryBackbone::pair`+attach scaffolding now uses `testkit::paired_apps::<FlowPlayApp>(channel)`. No `assert_ingest_idempotent`-shaped test existed in this crate; none added (not required to add new tests).

C1 naming: no change needed — `FlowPlayApp` already equals `PascalCase("flow-play") + "App"`.
C2/C3 regions: `//#region 🔖️Manifest` was already correctly named; added the missing `//#region 🧪️Tests` / `//#endregion 🧪️Tests` wrapper around the test module (previously unwrapped). Canonical region order (Constants, Types, DocumentHelpers, Terminology, CommandLabels, Panels, Render, FlowPlayApp, Manifest, Tests) was already correct — only the Tests wrapper was missing.
C4 layout: single-app crate (only one `impl DocumentApp for X`) — stays flat, no `pub mod app_<name>` wrapping needed.
Step 4 (resource_kind): already present on the `AppBuilder` chain (`.resource_kind(ResourceKindSpec { id: "computation.flow", .. })`) from the prior Wave-1 pass — verified, not touched.
C6: verified via Cargo.toml grep — no other crate depends on `flow-plugin`, and flow-plugin depends only on `flow_core`, `protocol`, `semio-framework-plugin`, `vcs` (all framework/SDK, not another app's plugin crate).

Verification performed: rustfmt --check --config-path ./rustfmt.toml on lib.rs parsed with zero syntax errors (only pre-existing style diffs — the git HEAD original already had 42 rustfmt-diff hunks against this repo's rustfmt.toml before I touched it, my version has 37, i.e. no new formatting regressions, likely a rustfmt-version mismatch predating this change). Manual brace-balance check (365 open / 365 close). Exhaustive grep across flow/**/*.rs (excluding pkg/target build artifacts) confirmed zero residue of every removed identifier (FLOW_LABELS_NATIVE_EN/DE, flow_widget_drag_data, fn flow_labels, local tree_item/UiTreeNode-construction pattern, ActionMeta/MemoryBackbone test imports) and confirmed FlowPlayLabels/FlowPlayApp/FLOW_PLAY_APP_ID usage is internally consistent. Diffed against a pre-edit snapshot (lib.rs.orig in the ticket folder) to confirm the change's scope (416 changed lines).

Deliberately skipped: `cargo check -p flow-plugin` — invoked in background but produced zero output after several minutes (consistent with this repo's documented 100+-concurrent-cargo-process lock contention); did not block further per the verification policy. Full compile/test confirmation is deferred to the orchestrator's final workspace-wide gate.

Nothing found that couldn't be expressed with existing SDK primitives — this crate mapped cleanly onto PanelKit/Terminology/Testkit with no gaps (consistent with it having been one of the original reference sources for the SDK extraction).
